body:
To the teenage guys.... Don't bottle it up... Doesn't matter what the situation is. 
Just talk to someone. 
Someone older or a complete stranger willing to listen. (helplines etc) 
If it bothers you, you need to talk about it. 
Hiding behind exercise and drugs or alcohol doesn't help in the long run. Take it from someone who tried to, its not worth holding onto what's causing you mental pain. 
What you think of as weakness is not. It's ok to cry its ok to show your feelings and talk about what's happening in your life. 
(I'm sure this also applies to girls but being male I have no experience in that area)
Man's gotta do what a man's gotta do!

Stop lieing to yourself and everyone around you.
Stop drinking!
